parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: $\left(\frac1{\cos x}-\tan x\right)\left(\frac1{\sin x}+1\right)=\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}=\frac1{\tan x}$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$\left(\frac1{\cos x}-\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\right)\left(\frac1{\sin x}+1\right)$. B1 — Uses $\tan x=\sin x\div\cos x$ throughout.
$\left(\frac{1-\sin x}{\cos x}\right)\left(\frac{1+\sin x}{\sin x}\right)$ or $\frac{1-\sin^2x}{\cos x\sin x}$. M1 — Correct algebra leading to two or four terms.
$\frac{\cos^2x}{\cos x\sin x}$. A1 — OE. A correct expression which can be cancelled directly to $\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}$, e.g. $\frac{\cos^2x(1-\sin x)}{\sin x(1-\sin x)}$.
$\frac{\cos^2x}{\cos x\sin x}=\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}=\frac1{\tan x}$. A1 — AG. Must show cancelling. If $x$ is missing throughout, withhold this mark.
Total: 4

parts.official_mark_scheme_text:

$x=38.4^\circ$. A1 — AWRT. Ignore extra answers outside $0^\circ$ to $180^\circ$, but A0 if within.
